notes.title: 🔥 HUMANS ARE NOT THAT AGAINST LIZARDWOMEN 2 - DEMO IS OUT NOW 🔥
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/43d8f05d421b808c9065c5f6342694d28220576a.png[/img]

[b]An epic adventure [/b]where brave Rus warriors clash with seductive lizard invaders from the melting glaciers! Steamy scenes, exciting match-3 gameplay, full voice acting, and a surprisingly deep, twisted plot await!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/9903281567113536771f9e30a61114be1fcdb073.png[/img]

[h1]Play part 1 now: [/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715650

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/95b5d61727d4a01cc3190162c2b7e517daf30b4f.png[/img]

[b]Didn’t get enough of sexy lizards and red-haired maidens?[/b] Don’t worry — the story continues! Very soon we’ll be releasing a fiery Part 2 with even more gorgeous girls, hot reptilian temptresses, spicy scenes, and wild plot twists! Right now you can check out the demo version of Part Two ⬇️

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/3afa7c9316b3a64152b7e2f49787795e74bfaf3f.png[/img]

🐉[b]A fresh story arc with new threats [/b]- unlike before, but just as intriguing;

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/7a1e2cfeac831d9fd2c43327c70fb0d36c37389e.png[/img]

🐉[b]Dolboslav takes the spotlight[/b], kicking off the chaos;

Fan favorites [b]Veinte, Ratibor, Gachislav, and Gachislava return[/b] - fully voiced from the start;
English voiceover is also available (partially for now);

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/abcb57011849bcc5a8f929318554e9ffe7d68c1a.png[/img]

🐉[b]New characters[/b] - both kind and sinister (yes, even some capitalist demons 😈);

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/4417a5dd1b8c0d8ce1563caea9dfaa4e7c1ef658.png[/img]

[i]And of course - steamy scenes and gorgeous art - just how you like it 🔥🔥🔥[/i]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/0fa93094856b0153bfb39c630bccd0e4e038604a.png[/img]

[h1] ⚡ If you like what you see, play the demo and add the game to your wishlist - that’s the best way to support us right now  ⚡[/h1]
